column1: # function id (RVA, from docs/data/frame_path_functions.tsv) | scenes that execute it | [V]/[I]
# Scene codes: fp=first person world, tp=third person with mob and nametag, weather=rain/snow,
# particles=particles (hit mob / break block), held=held item and block, fluid=water/lava,
# blockent=chest/sign, vv=Vibrant Visuals on and off, rp=resource pack with custom material,
# menu=inventory/menu, f1=F1 / HUD hidden, dim=dimension change, joinleave=world join/leave,
# resize=window resize, rtx=RTX world (if hardware available), all=every scene.
# [V] = scene linkage proven: the function is on the per-frame backbone and fires in every
# scene (submit/endFrame/dragon endFrame 1:1:1 per frame [V], BGFX_MAP.md 6b; live object uses
# the RTX submit override as its slot-50 target [V live, BGFX_MAP.md 6b]).
# [I] = inferred from the frame-path table (insert tag / visitor role / extractor input), not
# from a live run; in-game confirmation deferred per the 2026-11-22 user decision (one big test).
# Every lifted frame-path function below is assigned to at least one scene.
# Editor-only inserts (Editor tags 0-6) are exercised by none of the 16 scenes and are omitted.
